title: Fixed Cupped Crown and Long Eyed Shank Anchor
description: One wholly newly authored complete static cupped-crown and long-eyed-shank anchor prop. A single continuous closed material body has a finite flat central sole, a rounded outward-rising circular crown, a full thick rim, a real upper concave cup and a long central tapered shank grown directly from the cup centre. The head is neither a shallow plate with a separate block on top nor a hollow open-bottom bell. A second complete elongated upright iron eye has a genuine transverse through-opening and a finite lower root inserted into the integral shank tip. There is no stock, paired arm, separate pointed palm, cross pin, decorative chain or ground pedestal. Unlike the stocked twin-fluke anchor, a full circular cupped crown replaces both arms and flukes. Unlike the architectural concave-dish support, the long shank is integral to the full deep crown, with no separate convex shoe or square upper and lower mounting plates. Two editable complete closed meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR surface roles, metre-style native Z up with full horizontal bounds-centred sole. One whole model zero scenes. Broad mushroom-anchor category only, original artistic radial profile, eye proportions and surfaces, not a replica of a particular museum object or any historical standard. Fixed rooted visual presentation only, no deployed seabed, water, chain, vessel, rigid-body setup, animation or interaction. No holding power, mooring performance, seabed suitability, pull direction, stability, strength, engineered connection, fatigue, manufacture, installation, salvage, anchoring operation or maritime safety capability made or verified.
